_doc: Phase 8b candidate config — two new Donchian variants. Backtest-only, NOT loaded by the scheduler.

_candidates.btc_donchian_1d: Hypothesis: 1d timeframe → fewer whipsaws than 4h, higher robustness. Trade count drops (estimated 4-10/year vs ~20/year on 4h) but per-trade-edge should rise. If BTC 4h gave Sharpe 0.98 full / 0.11 OOS, then BTC 1d on the same data should be more stable across regimes.
_candidates.sol_donchian_4h: Hypothesis: SOL has historically higher beta than BTC + more violent trends. Same Donchian 55/20 setup. Tests whether the strategy generalises across major-cap crypto perps OR whether BTC was a fluke. If SOL gives positive Sharpe, the Donchian edge is real and asset-agnostic; if SOL stinks, BTC was 2024-Bullrun-luck.
